title: Greek Spanakopita Stuffed Red Onions
description: A flavorful twist on traditional spanakopita, filled with the sweetness of caramelized red onions and the savory taste of juicy spinach.
instructions: Caramelize the red onions in olive oil over low heat for 20-25 minutes.
Unroll the spanakopita dough and cut it into 4 equal pieces.
Place a piece of dough into each red onion shell.
Spoon the caramelized onions and spinach mixture into the dough.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together.
Place the onions seam-side down on a baking sheet.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
